title: Dawa Bar | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Dawa Bar Located in Africa at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park Sip on South African wines in the heart of Harambe village at this bamboo bar by Tusker House Restaurant. African beer, including the elusive Tusker Lager, and specialty cocktails like Lost on Safari are also served.View Menu American Bars & Lounges Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Valid admission required.
